author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Carrasco elects free agency
impact: Carrasco passed through waivers. He'll likely seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Arraez (foot) back in lineup Friday
desc: Luis Arraez is back in the Giants lineup on Friday against the Braves.
impact: Arraez is back from a two-game absence. He is at second base and leading off.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Trout leaning against participating in home run derby
desc: Mike Trout told reporters he is leaning against doing the home run Derby.
impact: Trout cited his hamstring injury as the primary reason. He enters Friday having hit 17 home runs on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Phil Maton (knee) placed on IL
desc: The Cubs placed Phil Maton on the injured list with a recurring knee ailment.
impact: Maton does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Spence to pitch in bulk relief role Friday
desc: Mitch Spence is expected to make a bulk relief appearance on Friday against the White Sox.
impact: Spence was recalled from Triple-A on Friday. He is expected to pitch behind Steven Cruz.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: David Peterson to make Cubs debut Saturday
desc: David Peterson will make his Cubs debut on Saturday against the Brewers.
impact: Peterson has been added to the Chicago 26-man roster to replace Phil Maton, who hit the injured list. Peterson has struggled this season with the Mets, as he currently holds a 6.09 ERA in 68 innings pitched. A change in scenery could help the lefty, who pitched to a 2.90 ERA in 121 innings in 2024.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Tucker (back) returns to lineup Friday
desc: Kyle Tucker is back in the Dodgers lineup on Friday against the Padres.
impact: Tucker returns for the first time since Monday. He is batting sixth and starting in right field.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Evan Carter (oblique) officially sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Rangers sent Evan Carter on a rehab assignment to Double-A Frisco.
impact: Carter will bat leadoff and start in center field in his first rehab game on Friday. He should be activated by early July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Robert Suarez (forearm) placed on IL
desc: The Braves placed RHP Robert Suarez on the 15-day injured list with a right forearm strain.
impact: Suarez has been battling tightness in his forearm and was hopeful to avoid a stint on the IL, but he'll miss some time. Hurston Waldrep was activated from the injured list as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hurston Waldrep (elbow) activated from IL
desc: The Braves activated RHP Hurston Waldrep from the 15-day injured list.
impact: Waldrep makes his way back from an elbow injury. It is unclear what role he will be returning to.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Santana released by Diamondbacks
impact: Santana was designated for assignment earlier this week. The veteran will seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tsung-Che Cheng recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Red Sox recall INF Tsung-Che Cheng from Triple-A Worcester.
impact: Cheng will add depth in the infield for Boston with Marcelo Mayer placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcelo Mayer (forearm) placed on IL
desc: The Red Sox placed INF Marcelo Mayer on the 10-day injured list with a bone stress reaction to his left ulna.
impact: Mayer had been playing through the injury the past two months. He'll now miss some time to get fully healthy. He does not hold a timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Solak elects free agency
desc: Nick Solak has elected free agency.
impact: Solak refused his outright assignment by the Padres. He will seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lenyn Sosa (wrist) to resume rehab assignment soon
desc: Lenyn Sosa is expected to resume his rehab assignment soon.
impact: Sosa has not been in the lineup recently, but it wasn't a physical setback. He was tending to some personal matters related to the earthquakes in Venezuela.
